Sandbox_RCD_AllowManualTransmission_tool: Allows each client to select manual shifting in Mod Options. Disable to enforce automatic shifting.
Sandbox_RCD_AutoStart_tooltip: Requests an engine start when the driver applies throttle to a vehicle that can be started.
Sandbox_RCD_EasyTow_tooltip: Reduces the brake command applied by a vehicle while it is being towed.
Sandbox_RCD_RedlineRPM_tooltip: Target maximum engine speed used by the drivetrain model and automatic shift logic.
Sandbox_RCD_ReverseSpeedLimit_tooltip: Soft speed limit applied while reversing.
Sandbox_RCD_TorqueSport_tooltip: Scales calculated drive force for lightweight and performance-oriented vehicles.
Sandbox_RCD_TorqueStandard_tooltip: Scales calculated drive force for ordinary passenger vehicles.
Sandbox_RCD_TorqueHeavy_tooltip: Scales calculated drive force for heavy vehicles.
Sandbox_RCD_TorqueConverterLimit_tooltip: Maximum low-speed multiplication before the converter progressively locks. Higher values improve launch force but increase wheel slip.
Sandbox_RCD_AeroDragSport_tooltip: Aerodynamic drag coefficient for sport-class profiles.
Sandbox_RCD_AeroDragStandard_tooltip: Aerodynamic drag coefficient for standard passenger profiles.
Sandbox_RCD_AeroDragHeavy_tooltip: Aerodynamic drag coefficient for heavy profiles.
Sandbox_RCD_RollingResistance_tooltip: Constant rolling resistance on paved surfaces.
Sandbox_RCD_RollingResistanceSpeed_toolt: Additional paved-surface resistance that rises with speed.
Sandbox_RCD_OffroadRollingResistance_too: Constant rolling resistance while the vehicle is off road.
Sandbox_RCD_OffroadRollingResistanceSpee: Additional off-road resistance that rises with speed.
Sandbox_RCD_TractionEnabled_tooltip: Limits usable drive and braking force from surface, weather, and wheel state. Disable to retain the drivetrain without added grip limits.
Sandbox_RCD_OverallTraction_tooltip: Global grip scale applied after all surface and weather factors.
Sandbox_RCD_AccelerationTraction_tooltip: Grip scale used specifically while applying drive force.
Sandbox_RCD_OffroadTraction_tooltip: Remaining grip on off-road terrain. 1 keeps full grip; lower values increase slip.
Sandbox_RCD_WetTraction_tooltip: Remaining grip at maximum configured rain intensity.
Sandbox_RCD_SnowTraction_tooltip: Remaining grip at maximum snow strength.
Sandbox_RCD_SteeringRateLowSpeed_tooltip: How quickly steering input turns the wheels near standstill.
Sandbox_RCD_SteeringRateHighSpeed_toolti: How quickly steering input turns the wheels at or above the high-speed reference.
Sandbox_RCD_SteeringCenterLowSpeed_toolt: How quickly steering returns toward center near standstill.
Sandbox_RCD_SteeringCenterHighSpeed_tool: How quickly steering returns toward center at or above the high-speed reference.
Sandbox_RCD_SteeringSnapback_tooltip: Extra steering response when changing direction, limited by the current speed-sensitive rate.
Sandbox_RCD_SteeringHighSpeedReference_t: Speed where the high-speed steering and centering rates are fully applied. Values between zero and this speed are blended.
Sandbox_RCD_PlantImpulse_tooltip: Scales only the impulse added when the vehicle hits a plant. 0 removes that impulse; 1 keeps vanilla strength.
Sandbox_RCD_ZombieImpulse_tooltip: Scales only the impulse added when the vehicle hits a living pedestrian or zombie.
Sandbox_RCD_CorpseImpulse_tooltip: Scales only the impulse added when the vehicle drives over a corpse.
Sandbox_RCD_DynamicMassReference_tooltip: The shared scale is the reference mass divided by the heaviest loaded vehicle. Drive and resistance scale with mass; script mass is retained when every vehicle is lighter than the selected reference.
